For [formats](/docs/shell/commands/categories/formats/).

<div class='command-title'>Parse text as .toml and create record.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> from toml {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| string | record |
## Examples

Converts toml formatted string to record.
```nu
> 'a = 1' | from toml
╭───┬───╮
│ a │ 1 │
╰───┴───╯
```

Converts toml formatted string to record.
```nu
> 'a = 1
b = [1, 2]' | from toml
╭───┬───────────╮
│ a │ 1         │
│   │ ╭───┬───╮ │
│ b │ │ 0 │ 1 │ │
│   │ │ 1 │ 2 │ │
│   │ ╰───┴───╯ │
╰───┴───────────╯
```
